name: Noise Analysis
summary: Where electronic noise comes from, how to quantify it (SNR, noise figure) and how to design low-noise circuits.

topics.name: Thermal noise, shot noise, flicker noise (1/f)
Shielding, grounding, and layout for noise reduction
Noise models of resistors, BJTs, MOSFETs and op-amps
Noise spectral density and equivalent noise bandwidth
Input-referred noise and cascaded noise (Friis formula)
